Title: 497307-2026: France – Construction work – Energy renovation and restructuring of Building M of the École nationale supérieure d’Arts et Métiers, Angers Campus
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: University building/campus project is fundamentally relevant for sbp; however, since this is an energy renovation/restructuring in France without any apparent complex structural engineering tasks or checking engineer services, it is only of medium relevance.
titel: Energy renovation and restructuring of Building M of the École nationale supérieure d’Arts et Métiers, Angers Campus
kurzbeschreibung: Energy renovation and conversion of a university building with workshops and learning platform in Angers.
umfang: Energy renovation and restructuring of building sections M1 and M2 on the ENSAM campus. Measures include roof renovation and roof insulation, remediation of hazardous materials, repair of load-bearing structures, internal insulation, replacement of external windows, renewal of heating and lighting, as well as modernization of teaching rooms, workshops, storage areas, support areas and a technology platform. Execution in 14 lots, 1 basic tranche and 2 optional tranches, construction period 22 months plus 2 months preparation.
leistungen: Construction services in 14 specialist lots, including demolition, hazardous material remediation, shell construction, steel construction and metalwork, timber construction, roofing, waterproofing, exterior and interior finishing, electrical as well as HVAC/plumbing; no explicit planning services tendered, currently only prior information for a later open tender.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• University building generally of interest, as campus and educational buildings can be relevant for sbp.
• However, this is not for planning services, but a construction tender in 14 execution lots.
• No explicit need for structural design, checking engineer services or conceptual involvement is apparent.
• Structural relevance only indirect via repair of structures and steel and timber construction trades.
• Project size of EUR 9.3 million is solid, but strategically only of limited relevance for sbp without access to planning.
• No special spans, special structures or innovative lightweight construction aspects mentioned.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee for planning services specified. This is a prior information notice for construction services in several lots without an explicit planning contract for structural design or checking services.
auftraggeber: RECTORAT DE NANTES, 8 Rue General Margueritte 44000 Nantes, 44326 Nantes, France; Contact: RECTORAT DE NANTES - SCUS; E-mail: ce.scus@ac-nantes.fr; Telephone: 0251863077; Website: www.ac-nantes.fr; Procurement platform: https://www.marches-publics.gouv.fr
notes: Prior information, not an actual contract notice. Expected publication of the tender on 01/09/2026. Contract start 01/01/2027, duration 24 months. Estimated total value excluding VAT EUR 9.3 million.
